documentratinglist-empty: Shown by the {{#documentratinglist:}} parser function when no page in the category has enough ratings. Set the message to - to show nothing.
documentratinglist-error-category-empty: Error shown by the {{#documentratinglist:}} parser function when the first argument (category name) is empty.
documentratinglist-error-category-invali: Error shown by the {{#documentratinglist:}} parser function when the first argument is not a valid category name.
documentratinglist-error-count: Error shown by the {{#documentratinglist:}} parser function when the second argument is not an integer in range. Parameters: * $1 - minimum count * $2 - maximum count
documentratinglist-error-expensive: Error shown by the {{#documentratinglist:}} parser function when the expensive parser function limit of the page was exceeded.
